# M1 parallel completion work

Coordinator direction after A0, 2026-10-17. This preserves the [full M1 scope](M1-01.md) and the [Astra audit](../evidence/M1-COORDINATION-ASTRA.md). Source `558c28c`, author evidence `aa53661`, staged merge `1c8d81e`, is reconciled for **provisional dependent work, not accepted gameplay**. Root reran 117 tests/typecheck/build, economy and both formerly failing command-save diagnostics; see [coordinator evidence](../evidence/M1-A0-INTEGRATION.md).

## Team and ownership

All three workers use **Sol 6.1 max** in separate T3 worktrees from the same committed baseline. Root Astra xhigh alone dispatches, owns shared-interface decisions, records and Git assembly. Four concurrent agents including root. No worker spawns children or changes another worker's files.

| Assignment | Exclusive path family | Bounded result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [M1-CORE](M1-CORE.md) | Exact simulation/content/save/runtime/core-render/test paths listed in brief | Earned first expedition and second-session route, necessary core fixes, measured preparation/return margins |
| [M1-VISUAL](M1-VISUAL.md) | Six render leaf files and its evidence | Richer-cel first-expedition readability/atmosphere and simple carrier presentation within frozen physics |
| [M1-PRESENTATION](M1-PRESENTATION.md) | UI/CSS/audio, sound test and its evidence | Useful preparation/recovery guidance, notebook, warnings and presentation controls |

The root-facing core route assignment deliberately excludes ownership of the entire P4 recovery and F0–F3 carrier browser matrix. A separate physical-recovery/carrier assignment rotates into a completed slot after necessary interface changes are frozen. If a discovered route defect touches those mechanisms, core may fix only the directly blocking issue in its owned paths and report coverage. Full deep Bobbin and campaign carrier construction remain M2.

## Frozen shared boundaries

Read [CONTRACTS](../CONTRACTS.md#reconciled-a0-interfaces-for-provisional-m1-work) and [A0 exact dimensions](../evidence/M1-A0.md#exact-physical-contracts-proposed-to-root). Main core alone owns registry IDs/positions/costs/provenance, types/world, save schema and app lifecycle. Art reads `CARRIER_LAYOUT`, `carrierStructure`, `BERTH_ENVELOPES`, shared terrain/solids and existing scene interfaces. UI/audio reads commands/state/events and uses the transient `GameEvent.origin?: Vec3` correctly. No duplicated registry, invisible art-only air source, cosmetic relocation of colliding machinery or persistent-provenance copyediting.

Keep geometry, source positions, event/API shapes and save relationships stable while other workers consume this baseline. A necessary shared change returns as an exact proposal to root; root reconciles, commits and coordinates the dependent baseline. Rendering/material/camera requests from art belong to core; registry-copy requests from presentation belong to core. Continue independent work while a request is resolved, without creating competing implementations.

Each task ends with coherent commits, changed paths, actual checks and evidence, proposed shared changes, known failed/unexecuted criteria and closed owned resources. No pushes, PRs, parent merges or coordinator-record edits. Production work stays on the provisional feature branch until the named batches pass the dual gate. Completion notifications wake root; no worker waits/polls for peers.

## Combined play and acceptance

1. Root inspects and assembles each coherent result. If geometry/interfaces change, reconcile affected workers and evidence before freezing.
2. Close the separate physical recovery/carrier assignment and then run the combined source through P0–P5 and F0–F3. Per-worker art views, tests and route runs are attributed to their actual SHA; they do not automatically prove the later combined game.
3. Freeze **core/physical-feasibility** and **first-expedition presentation** completion batches together. Fresh non-author Astra xhigh and Sol max each review all delivered pieces and their integration on the same candidate, alongside root self-review. A0 is included in core scope. Do not launch a review ceremony per cosmetic edit or omit any delivered path.
4. After both accept, integrate into `game/siltwake`, perform the separate integrated M1 check and fresh dual review. Human enjoyment/duration and representative-GPU evidence remain explicitly unverified if unavailable.

## Browser and evidence rules for every worker

Before any browser/preview/screenshot/test read `/work/repos/fleet/BROWSER_RULES.md` when available and `docs/BROWSER_RULES.md`. Verify factory-worker/isolated Linux owns the browser; prefer T3 preview_status then preview_open. Use task-owned incognito storage and distinct free ports: core 5190, visuals 5191, presentation 5192. Check availability rather than killing a listener. Preserve human/shared tabs including historical tab14 and all other tasks' tabs/servers. Close only owned resources through normal lifecycle tools. Keep input/recording segments short enough to finish before tool timeout; do not let a timed-out script keep issuing controls.

Ordinary inputs establish gameplay. Imported, unmodified earned saves can support targeted replay, with origin SHA noted; seeded fixture/art staging and direct state diagnostics must remain labelled. Use actual game-camera captures and record source/bundle, hardware/settings, input method, source of saves and limitations. SwiftShader is not dedicated-GPU evidence; a muted host cannot establish an audible mix. No user-facing story spoilers.
